subject.title: fix(memory-core): honor private-network settings for OpenAI-compatible embeddings

question: Should configured OpenAI-compatible memory embeddings interpret omitted provider policy as exact-hostname trust, explicit false as fail-closed private access, and explicit true as broad private-network access?
rationale: This defines durable SSRF reachability and upgrade behavior; implementation correctness and tests cannot establish maintainer intent for that security contract.

options.title: Approve current contract
options.body: Accept exact-hostname compatibility when omitted, fail closed on explicit false, and allow broader private networking on explicit true.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Block every private endpoint unless `allowPrivateNetwork` is explicitly true, trading compatibility for a simpler security rule.

options.title: Preserve false compatibility
options.body: Continue exact-hostname trust when false is configured, reducing upgrade breakage but weakening explicit denial semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve current contract
recommendation.body: Accept exact-hostname compatibility when omitted, fail closed on explicit false, and allow broader private networking on explicit true.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available current-history signal spans the embedding provider, shared request resolver, and SSRF helper involved in this decision.
